name: tin-mcp
description: Read and write pages and spaces on projects.tinconnect.com (AppFlowy Cloud) with an API key.

tools.name: appflowy_server_info
tools.description: Check connectivity, identity, and key validity

tools.name: appflowy_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces the API key can access

tools.name: appflowy_get_page_tree
tools.description: Get the space/page tree of a workspace

tools.name: appflowy_read_page
tools.description: Read a page as markdown with section markers and doc_state_hash for optimistic concurrency

tools.name: appflowy_create_space
tools.description: Create a new space (top-level folder) in a workspace

tools.name: appflowy_create_page
tools.description: Create a page in a workspace, optionally with initial markdown content

tools.name: appflowy_update_page_section
tools.description: Replace a <!-- BEGIN/END GENERATED --> marked section in-place. Supports dry_run and if_unmodified hash for optimistic concurrency

tools.name: appflowy_insert_section
tools.description: Append a new marked section (with auto-generated BEGIN/END GENERATED markers) to a page

tools.name: appflowy_restore_page
tools.description: Restore a page from a local pre-write backup snapshot

tools.name: appflowy_list_backups
tools.description: List all local pre-write backup snapshots for a page

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Create one at https://projects.tinconnect.com → Settings → API access. Shown once at creation.
